title: Claude Code CLI approval record
description: Written only by spikes/spike1-cli.ps1 to Build/data/generator/cli-approval.json. Read by the Dashboard's CLI gate (src/main/generator/cli-gate.ts) before every CLI launch. The Dashboard runs the CLI only if status is "approved", harness >= the gate's MIN_HARNESS, the installed binary's SHA-256 equals sha256, and the binary reports version.

status.description: approved: every required check passed in at least one qualifying run and none failed. blocked: a required check failed in a qualifying run. incomplete: not every required check has passed yet.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact claude.exe the spike tested.

harness.description: Minimum spike harness version whose runs were counted.

decidedAt.description: UTC time the record was computed (ISO 8601).

failed.description: Required checks that FAILED in a qualifying run ("<id>|<check>").

missing.description: Required checks that have not PASSED in any qualifying run yet.
